URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/8/russian-strikes-near-ukrainian-capital-kill-three-including-child
(WebFetch extract — Al Jazeera newsroom, 8 August 2026)

Casualties/locations: Four people killed in Russian strikes near Kyiv — a grandfather, grandmother, and 3-year-old grandson died in Pukhivka, Brovary District, from a double-tap drone strike. One additional person killed in the capital during a ballistic missile attack.

Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil infrastructure: Ukraine's military targeted Russia's Ilsky and Syzran oil refineries overnight, causing fires at both facilities. Ukraine also launched long-range drones at a Wildberries warehouse in Ekaterinburg.

Direct quotes:
- Zelenskyy accused Putin of "desperately clinging to his ballistic missiles and drones to keep the war going."
- Sven Coppens, Plan International director: "We observe that multiple missiles are being launched at the same area within a short period of time."

Air-defence interceptor shortage: Zelenskyy said "Ukraine received only a third as many air-defence missiles in the first half of this year as it had during the same period in 2025." He attributed this shortfall to "the US-Israel war on Iran, which has drawn down global stockpiles of air defence interceptors."
